evaluation_name: Lab Evaluation 2 - GAN Models with Other Deep Learning Models

team.project: ReliefPlan AI: AI-Powered Disaster Relief Camp Planning

student_gan_models.generator_architecture: U-Net 256 (8 Down, 8 Up with Skip Connections)
student_gan_models.use_case_in_case_study: Generates crisp, highly structured UNHCR camp blueprints conditioned directly on paired post-disaster satellite imagery.

student_gan_models.generator_architecture: ResNet-6 (6 Residual Bottlenecks with Reflection Padding)
student_gan_models.loss_formulation: L_GAN(G_AB, D_B) + L_GAN(G_BA, D_A) + 10 * L_cyc + 5 * L_identity
student_gan_models.use_case_in_case_study: Enables zero-shot camp layout generation on disaster sites where paired layout annotations do not exist by learning cycle-consistent domain translation.

ongoing_models_comparison.primary_strength: Reliable semantic classification with skip connections
ongoing_models_comparison.primary_limitation: High parameter count (~31M), requires separate downstream heuristic solver for blueprints

ongoing_models_comparison.paradigm: Supervised Discriminative Semantic Segmentation with Multi-Scale Dilated Convolutions
ongoing_models_comparison.loss_formulation: Weighted Cross-Entropy (LoveDA class balanced) + Soft Dice Loss
ongoing_models_comparison.primary_strength: Ultra-lightweight (~3.9M params), ASPP captures multi-scale context without downsampling
ongoing_models_comparison.primary_limitation: Predicts terrain only; layout optimization is performed via downstream constraint engine
